svg.title: Lepidiline A and bacillimidazole A
svg.desc: Two natural products with a permanently cationic imidazolium ring highlighted in light red. Lepidiline A from maca has two N-benzyl substituents. Bacillimidazole A from a marine Bacillus has two N-phenethyl substituents. Both have methyl groups at C4 and C5 and hydrogen at C2. Cations are drawn without counterions.
